products.name: Creatify Max
products.tagline: Your ad teammate, from strategy to creation to launch
products.description: Max is your teammate for paid ads. Share a product URL or brief and Max makes video ads, sets up campaigns on Meta and TikTok, and watches results 24/7, flagging what to fix next. You make the calls: nothing goes live without your approval.

products.name: RankSpot
products.tagline: Pay-as-you-go SEO and AI Search execution layer for agents
products.description: RankSpot is the SEO and AI Search execution layer for agents. Connect the MCP to Claude or ChatGPT in 2 minutes and your agent does the work: it writes articles from what already ranks on Google in 100+ languages, publishes them, and pitches ranking sites from your mailbox for backlinks. Run every client or business from one chat. No subscription: $3 an article, $0.004 a prompt check, reading your data free. Start with $1 of credit and a free article.

products.name: TheBold
products.tagline: Turn execution into meetings with investors
products.description: TheBold turns startup execution into direct investor access. 🎉 Launch Fast Track (Nov 17–27): pass one AI investor-readiness interview, land in the deal flow of investors who match your startup, and unlock direct meeting access. TheBold helps founders understand investor criteria, track and verify execution and traction, practice investor-specific AI simulations, and book meetings once qualified.

products.name: Appxiom
products.tagline: Context layer for AI coding agents to detect & fix bugs
products.description: Appxiom gives your coding agent the production context it lacks: crashes, freezes, memory leaks, failed network calls and broken user journeys in mobile and web applications. Goal Friction Impact lets agents prioritise bugs by the goals they cost you. Supports Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Java), iOS (Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C), Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform and Web (all JavaScript / TypeScript frameworks, with special support for React).

products.name: EkLine
products.tagline: AI SEO for Developer Tools and API first companies!
products.description: Your buyers ask ChatGPT which tool to use, then ask Cursor to build with it. EkLine helps your API or developer tool succeed at both. Its AI agents audit your website, docs, GitHub, and community content to find what AI misunderstands or can't implement. Then they prioritize gaps, write code-grounded fixes as pull requests your team approves, and retest AI responses to measure what improved.

products.name: Versine
products.tagline: Let your AI send and receive money. We're Venmo for agents.
products.description: Send and receive money with AI. Connect it to ChatGPT, Claude, Instinct, Muse, or your own agent through our MCP. Recipients don’t need a Versine account: they can cash out straight to their bank. Each transfer is approved by your passkey or sent autonomously to trusted contacts that you set.

products.name: superlog
products.tagline: Finds the production bugs your monitoring never sees
products.description: Your monitoring only alerts on what you told it to watch, so customers still report bugs. Superlog finds the errors nobody set an alert for, investigates them 24/7 and hands you a fix. 100+ startups use it; 87% of our fixes get merged.

products.name: VINC
products.tagline: Bring your filmmaking vision to life.
products.description: You know the scene, the mood, the camera movement, and how your film should feel. VINC helps you work on the rest. Develop your script, sketch your storyboard, plan and generate your shots, with room to review and refine at every stage. Finally, bring all your generated shots into the built-in editor, where SFX and BGM are taken care of, and deliver your final output.

products.name: seshka
products.tagline: Kill what Claude Code left behind
products.description: Claude Code sessions end. The dev servers, watchers and scripts they started don't. seshka shows them in your menu bar, grouped by session, with memory and ports. Kill them in one click. End idle sessions too, by hand or automatically. Free and open source.

products.name: UI Verify
products.description: UI Verify shows your coding agent every screen its change touched, so the agent catches and fixes its own UI bugs before your users see them. Used by teams at JetBrains, Cura and Metica. Works with Playwright, Storybook, Vitest and Bun, and with iOS and Android apps. Set up in one line. Free to start, and free for open source: 50,000 snapshots a month.

products.name: Arcade
products.tagline: AI video generator for marketing teams
products.description: Arcade is the AI video generator for marketing teams. Describe what you want, answer two questions, and get an on-brand product video in minutes. Start from a prompt, a screen recording, or what you already have in Notion, Linear, Google Drive, GitHub, and Granola. Your Brand Kit, natural voiceover, and every scene editable. Then post straight to YouTube, LinkedIn, and X. Free to start.

products.name: uRun
products.tagline: Real-time decisions for voice and video agents
products.description: Sense is a real-time decision model for voice and video agents. It runs on streaming audio and video and answers your questions about the conversation many times per second: is the user done speaking, did they just interrupt, should the agent stop talking. You write the questions, Sense returns the decisions, and your agent acts on them. Build with the SDK for real-time sessions, or send single requests to explore. New accounts start with 1,000 in free credits.

products.name: Afterall Photo
products.tagline: Line up your after photo exactly with your before
products.description: Afterall puts your earlier photo on the live camera as a see-through ghost, so every after-shot lines up with the before. Export the change as a crossfade, a reveal or side by side. No account, no server, Pro is a one-time purchase.

products.name: Dream by Smart Jelly
products.tagline: An AI agent that works through your tasks overnight
products.description: Dream helps you make progress on your tasks while you sleep. It works through tasks it can finish on its own overnight and shows you what it did in the morning. Dream is part of Smart Jelly, a Mac app whose tools share memory of your work.

products.name: Yetly
products.tagline: Small real-world challenges near you, on your own map
products.description: Yetly turns real places around you into small challenges: have a picnic by a lake, join a guided tour, cycle to a park. Browse nearby ideas across nature, cycling, hiking, culture and city exploring, or grab a ready-made day plan with a few easy stops. Each challenge you finish becomes a footprint on your own map, and you can turn it into a share card. Free for iPhone, no account needed.
